name: Half-Integrally Representable Ample Classes Are Contained in Fractionally Representable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Half-Integrally Representable Ample Classes belongs to Fractionally Representable Ample Classes.
proof: Integral unit-budget coefficients belong to {0,1}; half-integral nonnegative full allocations are fractional allocations.
